meta.source: OKLCH 12-step scales generated from seeds: primary/secondary/tertiary from the 2026 portfolio PDF, status seeds and family structure from Oren's Focus-style template; semantic tokens alias scale steps.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Alternate section background (Behind the work). One band at a time; never stagger.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Screenshot frame and placeholder fill.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Screenshot cards on an accent block or band.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, links.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text for descriptions and captions.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text at 14px and up: metadata, years, captions. APCA Lc 76–79. Not for 12px eyebrows; those use ink.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Field labels in the large serif contact list only (22px+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The 28px header dot grid. Decorative.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Link hover and focus color.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: IMAX case band and card block. Quiet step 7 in dark. Text: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-navy
tokens.usage: Amex case band, card block, résumé section. Quiet step 7 in dark. Text: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: LHW case band and card block. Quiet step 7 in dark. Text: on-accent-orange.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-navy and accent-violet.

tokens.name: on-accent-orange
tokens.usage: Text on accent-orange. Light mode: large text only (see on-tertiary). Dark mode band (tertiary-7) takes any size.

tokens.name: on-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Kept for compatibility; equals on-accent. No tint lighter than the band reaches APCA Lc 75 on violet, so show inactive items with regular weight instead of a lighter color.

tokens.name: accent-violet-dot
tokens.usage: Dot rule for the IMAX case; a soft tint in dark.

tokens.name: accent-navy-dot
tokens.usage: Dot rule for the Amex case; a soft tint in dark.

tokens.name: accent-orange-dot
tokens.usage: Dot rule for the LHW case; a soft tint in dark.
